services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: DCP offers an array of summer camps each year for our young actors ages 4-16. In addition to our usual 1-week offerings, this year we are piloting 2-week performance intensives, which will include a full production experience for campers who want a true show experience. We also offer exciting partnerships with local businesses, like the Dungeons and Dragons gaming group Young Dragonslayers. DCP summer camps enrich the school experience by fostering creativity, communication, collaboration, confidence, cultural understanding, critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and life skills. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: DCP offers field trips throughout the year to local schools and homeschools. Taking a field trip to the theatre offers numerous benefits for students that extend beyond the classroom walls. Taking a field trip to the theatre offers students a unique and valuable educational experience that complements classroom learning, promotes cultural enrichment, and fosters personal and social development. It is an investment in students' holistic education and well-being, providing them with opportunities for growth, inspiration, and connection to the world around them. services.name: Our Youth Ensemble Classes
services.desc: These classes focus on the development of the actor through the production process. Students begin the semester with a healthy dose of instruction and training in theatre. They will learn how to articulate their ideas clearly, project their voices, use body language effectively, and interpret the emotions and intentions of others. The class will then move into rehearsals for the workshop production. They will begin analyzing scripts, interpreting characters, and making creative choices. Theatre is inherently collaborative, requiring students to work together as a team to bring a production to life.
